Subject: Phone screen availability — Redwood Inference

Hi Clarissa,

Thanks again for applying to Redwood Inference for the Product PM role — I'm Marissa on the Talent team. We'd love to set up a 30-minute phone screen with Jonas (hiring manager) to go over your background and next steps.

Before I propose times: what timezone are you in and which morning windows work best for you next week? For reference, Jonas is on Pacific time (PDT / UTC-7). If you prefer, here are some candidate windows — all in SGT (UTC+8):

- Tue/Wed/Thu 9:00–11:00 AM SGT
- Fri 10:00–12:00 PM SGT

If those don't work, tell me 2–3 specific slots (with timezone) and we'll do our best to accommodate. Call will be 30 minutes via Google Meet; I'll include an invite and dial-in once we confirm.

Attached is our short interview guide and feel free to reply with your latest resume if you'd like (or just confirm the one we have).

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0112

Hi Marissa (and Jonas),

Thanks — I'm based in Singapore (SGT, UTC+8). Mornings are best for me next week. I can do:

- Tue 10:00–11:00 AM SGT (Aug 10)
- Wed 9:00–10:00 AM SGT (Aug 11)
- Thu 9:30–10:30 AM SGT (Aug 12)

All times above are in SGT. 30 minutes is perfect.

I reviewed Clarissa's times (SGT mornings). I'm on Pacific time (PDT / UTC-7) and my recurring commitments free up late afternoons here. The easiest overlap I can reliably do is 5:30 PM PDT on Mon/Tue/Thu, which converts to 8:30 AM SGT the following day.

If we offer Clarissa 8:30 AM SGT on Tue (Aug 10) that's 5:30 PM PDT on Mon (Aug 9) for me — that works. I'm fine with Google Meet, 30 minutes. Please propose one slot to Clarissa and include the Join URL + dial-in.
